name: 8 Lire XL
notes: The SOMA Lyra-8 in full, after its user manual (v2.1, somasynths.com): two delay lines (TIME and MOD each, LFO / SELF, TRI / SQ, one FEEDBACK with cross-feedback, MIX), the distortion after the delay (DRIVE, MIX, VOL), an FM or LFO source per pair, the 34>56 78>12 structure switch, PITCH per group, TOTAL FB, VIBRATO, the Hyper LFO's LINK, SHARP from triangle to square. Switches are 0..1 rows. Browser only: the FM-1 holds one delay.
